name: Mark 5.0 Blueprint Tee
description: Official cotton tee with the Anargya emblem on the chest and a full Mark 5.0 / #E71 technical blueprint print on the back. Available in white and black colorways. Crew-neck cut with ITS Automotive Team marks on the artwork.

name: A(N)rticle 01 Sticker Pack
description: Official Anargya sticker pack: driver mascot, Mark 5.0 car cuts, “Sobat Bengkel Kuning” nametag, CH453-TH3 Limit plate, and Anargya ITS 18 strip. Waterproof vinyl for laptops, bottles, and toolboxes.

name: Anargya Achievement Tumbler
description: Mint stainless tumbler with the Anargya emblem, Indonesia-Japan-Australia flags, competition laurels, and a Mark 5.0 car illustration. Double-wall vacuum insulation for paddock coffee or cold drinks on the go.

name: Anargya Logo Enamel Pin
description: Hard enamel pin of the Anargya infinity mark in green, red, and black with a silver metal outline and “ANARGYA” wordmark. Rubber clutch back. Wear it on a jacket, lanyard, or backpack.
